free_tier.stated: 1 show, 5 episodes on Free. 'unlimited episodes when you make your show available in Acast's advertising marketplace'. So free capacity is 5 episodes unless you opt into ad monetisation, in which case episodes are unlimited but storage is still bounded by the 150 MB file cap.

per_object_cap.stated: 150 MB per episode file: Acast sets the internal limit to 150MB, in line with Apple's 150MB cellular download limit; MP3 and M4A only
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.

egress.terms: Free distribution to all major platforms; no egress charge. Acast monetises via ads, not storage.

tooling: Dashboard only; no public upload API.
chaining: 5 episodes x 150 MB = 750 MB per free account in the honest reading; N accounts. Not interesting at scale.
